description: WP-G4 Codex: Orks (11e) RAMSHACKLE COVER (Big'ed Bossbunka): an attack that targets a unit not fully visible to the attacking model because of the Bossbunka gives the target the benefit of cover. Fixture ork11e_g4_cover (P2 Custodes' Shooting phase, open field with no terrain, the Bossbunka between the Custodian Guard and the Boyz). A real token click selects the Guard; hovering the Boyz shows the line-of-sight cover badge; the guardian spear is assigned with the panel's actions and the staged hit roll shows the benefit of cover (BS 2+ worsened to 3+). Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players 0 CP.

steps.comment: setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players 0 CP

steps.script:
var tm = TerrainManager
return tm.terrain_features.size() == 0 and bool(tm.unit_has_cover_11e(GameState.state.units["U_BOYZ_D"], GameState.state.units["U_GUARD_A"].models[1]))
steps.comment: open field (no terrain): the Boyz have cover only because the Bossbunka hides part of them
decline P2's stratagem window here (not under test)
decline P1's stratagem window here (not under test)
the guardian spear's BS 2+ is worsened to 3+ by the benefit of cover

steps.script:
var dock = tree.current_scene.get_node("ShootingController").resolution_dock
print("[g4] dock status: ", dock.status_label.text)
return dock.status_label.text.find("(cover)") >= 0
steps.comment: the dock's hit-roll line shows the benefit of cover
